title: Call Statistics
subtitle: Historical model calls stored on the current execution host. Data is not merged or synced across hosts; view requests, tokens, and cache hit rates by model, provider, and endpoint.

overview.description: Calls from the current execution host for {{timeRange}}, with dates and hours grouped in {{timeZone}}. Changing filters refreshes the data automatically.
